annotation.bound_parties_text: The plan is a strategic R&D priorities document that sets expectations for Federal agency AI R&D investment but imposes no binding obligations on named parties.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: While this Plan does not define specific research agendas for Federal agency investments, it does provide an expectation for the overall portfolio for Federal AI R&D investments.
annotation.dates_quote:
Deputy Assistant to the President for Technology Policy
June 21, 2019
annotation.robot_provision_quote: The National Artificial Intelligence R&D Strategic Plan: 2019 Update defines the priority areas for Federal investments in AI R&D.
